responsibility: This is the main implementation file of the AArch64 backend. It contains the bulk of the target-dependent code generation logic and hook implementations for AArch64, including ABI and calling-convention handling, register and addressing legitimacy, costing and vectorization support, builtin and atomic expansion helpers, assembly printing, scheduling and tuning decisions, security and memtag hooks, and many other machine-specific analyses and transformations; it culminates by binding those routines to GCC’s targetm hook table. In contrast to the .h, .md, and option files, this file is the executable C++ core of the port that turns GCC’s generic middle-end requests into AArch64-specific behavior across compilation stages.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem aarch64 files, this is the compiled backend implementation that defines the AArch64 target hooks and helper routines and then binds them through targetm. It differs from aarch64.h's macro and declaration header, aarch64.md's declarative RTL machine-description patterns and register/UNSPEC definitions, and aarch64.opt's generated-command-line option definitions and backing variables.
